verdict.rationale: Mastercard documents an Agent Toolkit/MCP server that lets AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf) ask natural-language questions about its services and get contextual answers plus dynamically generated code examples, which is a real natural-language interface layer. However, this is scoped to documentation Q&A and code generation for developers, not natural-language execution of the Open Finance product's actual financial operations (verify account, get balances, etc.) — missing for 10: evidence that NL commands can directly trigger/execute API actions (not just generate code), independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server, and coverage of NL control over the core finance workflows themselves.
